video.viewer: CommuniHacks 2026 hackathon judges seeing the project for the first time. Secondary: KW AccessAbility staff (Edward Faruzel, Robert Wismer) and future part-time drivers.
video.claim: AccessBus replaces the paper trip sheet for KW AccessAbility's one accessible bus. The office plans each run, the driver records the day in a few saved steps, and staff review the sheet and see the bus's costs (kilometres, hours, fuel, pay, repairs) on their own, separate from the rest of the agency.
video.pain_point: Today every trip is logged on a paper sheet. Drivers are part-time and may drive the bus rarely, so every run can feel like the first; staff are older adults who have to collect, correct and total the sheets by hand to report the bus's costs to the funder.
video.proof_moment: A driver signs in with a PIN and logs a whole trip in four saved steps (readings at the lot, pickup at the office, the trip and drop-offs, end readings and fuel); then Edward opens the completed trip, reviews it, corrects a number, and sees the bus totals update.
video.cta: Built at CommuniHacks 2026 for KW AccessAbility.
